title: The Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an essentially $v$-small category with $v$-small Hom sets and finite wide pullbacks, and let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology on $\mathcal C$ for which sheafification of $v$-small abelian-group-valued presheaves exists. Let $F$ be such an abelian sheaf, $X\in\mathcal C$, and $\mathfrak U=\{\pi_i:U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ a $v$-small family generating a $J$-covering sieve. Computing Ext in universe $v$, there exists a first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence with $E_2^{p,q}\cong\check H^p(\mathfrak U,\underline H^q(F))$ abutting to $H^{p+q}(X,F)$, where $\underline H^q(F)$ is the presheaf $V\mapsto H^q(V,F)$ and $\check H^p$ is the cohomology of the alternating Cech complex of the covering. The essential smallness records the small-site convention of Stacks Tag 00VI.

proof.text: Use Sheaf.isGrothendieckAbelian_of_essentiallySmall' with AddCommGrpCat and Mathlib's Grothendieck-category enough-injectives instance. Form injectiveResolution F and its specified Cech resolution double complex. This is valid under the source's small-site convention, unlike the previous HasExt-only general model.
The column theorem identifies inner cohomology as a complex with the Cech complex of the cohomology presheaf, including the horizontal differential.
The total theorem identifies total homology with F.Hprime using injective Cech row acyclicity and the section-complex comparison for the same injective resolution.

Apply exists_spectralSequence to that double complex. Compose each second-page isomorphism with the homology-functor image of the column isomorphism. Transport the abutment using AbutsTo.of_nonempty_iso and the total isomorphisms. This preserves all four steps of the unit route.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 21.10.6, with the small-site convention of 00VI; the equivalent injective-resolution double-complex route follows blueprint sk-thm-picard-cech Steps 1--4.

lean.statement:
theorem Sheaf.exists_cechToDerivedSpectralSequence [EssentiallySmall.{v} C]
    [HasExt.{v} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v})]
    (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (X : C)
    {ι : Type v} {U : ι → C} (π : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X) (hπ : Sieve.ofArrows U π ∈ J X) :
    ∃ E : E₂CohomologicalSpectralSequenceNat AddCommGrpCat.{v},
      (∀ p q : ℕ, Nonempty ((E.page 2).X (p, q) ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor fun i ↦ Over.mk (π i)).obj
          ((Over.forget X).op ⋙ F.cohomologyPresheaf q)).homology p)) ∧
      E.AbutsTo fun n ↦ F.H' n X

statement_change.old_statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, let $X$ be an object of $\mathcal C$, let $\mathfrak U=\{U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ be a covering, and let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on $\mathcal C$. There is a convergent first-quadrant spectral sequence

$$
E_2^{p,q}=\check H^p(\mathfrak U,\underline H^q(F))\Longrightarrow H^{p+q}(X,F),
$$

where $\underline H^q(F)$ is the presheaf $V\mapsto H^q(V,F)$ and $\check H^p(\mathfrak U,-)$ is Cech cohomology with respect to the covering $\mathfrak U$.
statement_change.what: Source-encoding correction under brief step 5: Stacks 00VI disallows big sites. The former Lean claim permitted an arbitrary large C and an independent universe w under HasExt alone, exceeding the source and lacking a valid realization model. Record the small-site convention using EssentiallySmall in coefficient universe v; use v for covering indices and Ext, and derive enough injectives rather than adding it as an assumption. This is an interface correction, not a proof of the former generality.
